name: Trigger Area
description: An invisible area that knows who is standing in it. Name it, scale it with the gizmo, then have a script react to that name.

changelog.notes: The runtime modules it used to carry now live in one place per scene, at src/scripts/runtime/ — updating removes this folder's copy, so a Script of yours that imports '../../custom/trigger_zone/scripts/runtime/zoneBus' has to import './runtime/zoneBus' instead.
Ships an AI guide (ai.md) the in-app assistant reads before it writes area code — the full bus API, where a reaction script goes, and the params, describing this exact copy.

Area settings read as settings, not as a script file. 'cooldown' is now 'exitDelay' — it is boundary hysteresis, not a reaction's rate limit, so it no longer collides with a reaction's own cooldown (the old value resets to the default). The bus can also resolve a reaction's area from the entity it sits on, so a reaction attached to the area needs no configuring at all.
Initial release: a named trigger area publishing occupancy on its bus module
